stage: question-first editorial draft before local candidate tables
independence: Author saw legacy and prior packet; not blind or independently validated. Fresh held-out probes must come from another reviewer.

questions.text: Which material object are we following when it heats without breaking?
questions.interpretation_seed: Identity continuity vs thermal change; boundary/identity policy is an upstream issue.

questions.text: How much matter does the same bounded object contain?
questions.interpretation_seed: Mass must not mean amount of substance.

questions.text: Can a hole be observed separately from the solid hosting it?
Did the boulder remain one object after it cracked into detached pieces?
questions.interpretation_seed: Cessation requires bounded fragmentation occurrence and new identities.

questions.text: Which parts of this rock are in physical contact?
questions.interpretation_seed: Contact does not entail attachment or common identity.

questions.text: Is the hot stone bigger after warming?
questions.interpretation_seed: Volume and temperature are distinct dependent observables; thermal expansion is a mechanism.

questions.text: Did the quantity of material change when fragments moved away?
questions.interpretation_seed: Open boundary material accounting vs identity loss.

questions.text: Does an unmoving stone have no physical processes?
questions.interpretation_seed: Stillness in a chosen frame cannot establish absence of thermal change.

questions.text: Is the same specimen uniform for both temperature and composition?
questions.interpretation_seed: Homogeneity must name a property and support scale.

questions.text: Can two objects have equal mass but different volumes?
questions.interpretation_seed: Independent qualities, not one size category.

questions.text: When does a crack become a separate void rather than a surface mark?
questions.interpretation_seed: Identity and host dependence need explicit criteria.

questions.text: What evidence would show that the object ceased to exist as that object?
questions.interpretation_seed: Collapse is identity loss, not missing sensor data.

questions.text: Does a warmer classification mean a larger change in temperature?
Can the mass of an absent observation be treated as zero?
questions.interpretation_seed: Evidence absence cannot resolve a quality or create cessation.

questions.text: Which physical distinctions must every specialized domain import rather than redefine?
questions.interpretation_seed: Root vs physical scope gate, not an extra domain taxonomy.
